WHERE  U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
        AND    U.PROGRAM_ID                    = V_PROGRAM_ID

        AND    U.COLUMN_NAME NOT IN ('VERSION_NO', 'MEASURE')
